svg.text: t20-exact-forecast: every module, script and file, and what depends on what
Read from the code. Blue rails carry imports; black lines carry files. Columns are stages, left to right.
three leagues vs the real targets
reloads the public files, fits 6 tiers
as submitted and after one change,
environment/app/engine/model.py is league/engine.py; league_io.py is copied; public.json is PublicConstants.from_calibration(Calibration.load()).
solution/reference_forecaster.py is forecasters/ladder.py with one import rewritten. tests/pristine/engine/ is a second copy of the same engine.
At grading, the verifier hashes the agent's /app/engine against tests/pristine/engine and runs /app/solution beside the pristine copy, never beside the agent's.
public file: the agent sees it
imports (dot = tap on that module's rail)
